关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: The Walt Disney Company issued a press release on February 9, 2016, detailing its results for the quarter ended January 2, 2016. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The report outlines the company's financial performance and operational results for the quarter. The filing is part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release provides insights into the company's financial condition and operational outcomes for the specified period.
